connector.name: MCP Server by vectros-ai
connector.registryDescription: Typed record store + hybrid search over MCP: deterministic lookups + semantic memory, per-customer.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the vectros-ai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: VECTROS_API_KEY
env.description: Vectros API key. Use a least-privilege scoped key (ssk_...); mint one with `npx -y @vectros-ai/cli bootstrap`. Required for a registry install, which cannot assume any other tooling is present. If you also install the vectros CLI (0.9.0+), the server can instead resolve the key from its keyring and this can be left unset.

env.name: VECTROS_KEYRING_ALIAS
env.description: Optional. When VECTROS_API_KEY is unset and the vectros CLI is installed, resolve this keyring entry instead of the active one.

env.name: VECTROS_API_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the API base URL (default https://api.vectros.ai). Must be an official *.vectros.ai host.

env.name: VECTROS_MCP_TOOLS
env.description: Comma-separated subset of tool names to register (default: all 21 tools).
